column3: H A R B O U R C O U N C I L M I N U T E S
The council met on the fourth of March in the old customs house. Eleven members were present and two sent apologies. The chair opened the meeting at seven o ' clock.

The council agreed to repaint the north pier before the summer season. A proposal to extend the fish market was postponed until the budget is known. Members thanked the volunteers who cleared the slipway after the February storm.
